headline: Euro India Fresh Foods submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Euro India Fresh Foods Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a standard compliance filing required of listed companies following shareholder meetings. Retail shareholders can review the voting outcomes for resolutions passed during the meeting on the exchange portal. The filing has negligible impact on the company's stock price or financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price
